source_diagnosis.reader_path: Coordinator::Commit holds unique snapshot_mutex_ across update/flush/publish; Coordinator::Hybrid requires shared snapshot_mutex_ across both stores. This is consistent with reader wait under concurrent writer, but wall latency is also exposed to uncontrolled host contention.
source_diagnosis.gc_path: CollectBeforeGeneration also holds unique snapshot_mutex_ and commit_mutex_; gc_m4_search_delete_ms directly times the generation SearchFilter plus per-hit Delete loop.
source_diagnosis.decision: Prioritize a bounded correctness-preserving investigation of read-lock hold time and generation GC search/delete cost; no performance optimization or architecture promotion is justified by this one contention-mismatched pair.
